description: Producción de Agua Potable, 2018- 2026 is a dataset listed in Dominican Republic national open data portal (datos.gob.do), an open data portal, published or maintained by Corporación del Acueducto y Alcantarillado de Moca | CORAAMOCA. Este conjunto de datos contiene la Producción de Agua Potable de la Corporación del Acueducto y Alcantarillado de Moca (CORAAMOCA),, generadas en el periodo 2018-2026, en el cual se puede encontrar la relación de la cantidad de galones mensuales de agua potable producido por cada uno de los sistemas de acueductos. Coverage: República Dominicana. The portal files it under the publisher Corporación del Acueducto y Alcantarillado de Moca | CORAAMOCA. Its tags are Acueducto y Alcantarillados, Agua, BIENESTAR SOCIAL. It offers 3 resource(s) in CVS, ODS, XLSX. The portal shows 2026-09-07 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-do-portal.
